en.name: Radicchio
en.summary: Radicchio is the deep red, white-veined chicory sold as a tight round head or as elongated Treviso spears, bitter raw and sweeter grilled. Refrigerated at 4 °C (40 °F) or below it keeps about 2–3 weeks — far longer than any lettuce.
en.pantry: Radicchio should not be kept at room temperature. It is a chicory rather than a lettuce, and it is much sturdier, but a warm kitchen still wilts the outer leaves within a day and turns the cut base brown. There is no room-temperature figure here and none should be assumed. Refrigerate the head whole and unwashed as soon as you get home.
en.fridge: Keep radicchio whole and unwashed in the crisper at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, loosely bagged or wrapped, where it keeps about 2–3 weeks — considerably longer than an iceberg and several times longer than a soft leaf lettuce. The tight head is what does it: the outer leaves protect everything inside, so peel leaves off as you need them rather than cutting the head in half. A cut face browns and dries, and a halved head will not last the week.
en.freezer: There is no freezer timeline for radicchio in our data, and freezing it raw makes no sense — the crisp bitter leaf is the point, and freezing collapses it. The useful exception is cooked: braised or grilled radicchio, cooled and frozen in portions, holds its flavour well and is exactly what you want for a risotto later. Freeze the dish, not the vegetable.
en.thawing: If you have frozen braised radicchio, reheat it from frozen in a pan or stir it straight into a risotto. Do not thaw raw radicchio and expect to serve it in a salad.
spoilage: Slimy or blackened outer leaves, especially at the edges
Brown or rust-coloured streaks along the white ribs
A soft, browning base with a sour smell
Leaves gone limp and leathery instead of snapping
tips: Choose heads that feel heavy and tight with crisp white ribs and a pale, dry cut base.
Keep the head whole; peel leaves from the outside as you need them.
Soak cut leaves in cold water for 20 minutes to take the hardest edge off the bitterness.
Grill or roast it with olive oil and a little balsamic — heat turns the bitterness sweet.

faq.q: How long does radicchio last in the fridge?
faq.a: About 2–3 weeks at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, kept whole and unwashed in the crisper — much longer than lettuce.
No timeline exists for raw radicchio and freezing it raw destroys the crisp leaf. Braise or grill it first and freeze the cooked dish in portions.

faq.q: How do you make radicchio less bitter?
faq.a: Soak the cut leaves in cold water for 20 minutes, or cook it — grilling and braising turn the bitterness into sweetness. Salt, fat and something acidic all help too.

faq.q: Is radicchio the same as red cabbage?
faq.a: No. Radicchio is a chicory, related to endive, with a bitter flavour and tender leaves. Red cabbage is a brassica, much denser and sweeter, and they behave nothing alike in cooking.

zh.name: 紫菊苣
zh.summary: 紫菊苣是深紅色帶白色葉脈的菊苣，有結球的圓形品種，也有細長的 Treviso 品種；生吃偏苦，炙烤後轉甜。4°C 以下冷藏約可放 2～3 週，比任何萵苣都久得多。
zh.pantry: 紫菊苣不應該放室溫。它屬於菊苣而不是萵苣，體質硬朗得多，但在溫暖的廚房裡，外層葉子一天內還是會萎，根部切口也會發褐。這裡不提供常溫保存天數，也請不要自行推估。買回家請整顆不清洗直接冷藏。
zh.fridge: 請整顆不清洗，鬆鬆裝袋或包好放在 4°C 以下的蔬果保鮮室，約可放 2～3 週——比美生菜長得多，更是軟質葉萵苣的好幾倍。關鍵就在那顆緊實的球：外層葉子保護了裡面的一切，所以請要用時從外面一片片剝，不要整顆對切。切面會褐變乾掉，切半的球撐不過一週。
zh.freezer: 我們的資料裡沒有紫菊苣的冷凍保存期限，而且生凍也說不通——爽脆帶苦的葉片就是它的重點，冷凍會讓它整個塌掉。唯一有用的例外是煮熟後：燜煮或炙烤過的紫菊苣放涼後分裝冷凍，風味保留得很好，之後拿來做燉飯正好。要冷凍的是那道菜，不是那顆菜。
zh.thawing: 如果冷凍的是燜煮好的紫菊苣，請不解凍直接下鍋回熱，或直接拌進燉飯裡。不要解凍生的紫菊苣還指望拿它做沙拉。
spoilage: 外層葉子變黏或發黑，尤其是葉緣
白色葉肋上出現褐色或鏽色條紋
根部變軟發褐並帶酸味
葉片變得軟韌像皮革，折起來不再清脆
tips: 挑拿起來有重量、包得緊實、葉肋白脆、根部切口乾爽淡色的。
保持整顆完整，要用時從外層一片片剝。
切好的葉子泡冷水 20 分鐘，可以去掉最尖銳的苦味。
淋橄欖油和一點巴薩米克醋炙烤或焗烤——熱度會把苦味轉成甜味。

faq.q: 紫菊苣放冰箱可以放多久？
faq.a: 4°C 以下冷藏，整顆不清洗放在蔬果保鮮室，約 2～3 週，比萵苣久得多。
生的沒有對應的期限，冷凍也會毀掉爽脆的葉片。請先燜煮或炙烤，再把成品分裝冷凍。

faq.q: 紫菊苣怎麼變得比較不苦？
faq.a: 切好後泡冷水 20 分鐘，或是加熱——炙烤和燜煮會把苦味轉成甜味。鹽、油脂和一點酸味也都有幫助。

faq.q: 紫菊苣和紫高麗菜一樣嗎？
faq.a: 不一樣。紫菊苣屬於菊苣類，和苦苣是親戚，味道偏苦、葉片柔嫩；紫高麗菜是十字花科，紮實得多也甜得多，兩者在料理上的表現完全不同。
